what_changes: Fault-profile FP-R5: worker 2's Fabric A egress is capped to 5 Mbit (5 percent of the 100 Mbit link) with no detector and no recovery, to measure the impact of a harsher rate-cap gray fault than the formal 20 Mbit point.
expected: Throughput retention degrades well below 0.8 while both interfaces stay up; the run records impact only and makes no recovery claim.
